title: Tide and Bakery
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Wren Whitlock, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
